about: Port decisions of AVAIL engineers (standard v0.11, R6): applied by the normalizer (normalize:library) and fill:catalog-ports, so ports copied again from the database keep them. A template matches by its label (manufacturer + model) or part number; the port by its label (old or new). Fields in set replace the port's.

set.notes: DP Alt Mode video + USB data

decisions.decision: USB-C with DP Alt is a video input, as on DTP3 T 322 D
shared IR / RS-232 port: serial in Control
power sense input of the MLC: a sensor input in Control
